pages.text: You pick your folk the first time you join. Each folk has a clear strength, one or two abilities on $(k:key.neoorigins.skill_1) and $(k:key.neoorigins.skill_2), a drawback you will feel, and its own size.$(br2)Abilities never hurt other players. Every class works with every folk, but each folk suits some classes best.
Press $(k:key.neoorigins.view_info) to read your folk's powers in game.
